summary_md: **FA33 ([@fernandoabishai](https://x.com/fernandoabishai/status/2115841105598054555))** discusses *Skill Dreaming* ([arXiv 2610.36188](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36188)), which evolves repository skills for coding agents from streams of reviewed pull requests, while wanting evidence that it beats well-maintained docs and tests rather than just a static prompt.

referenced_urls.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
